posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
I did see the tokens in the kickstarter update, and I might go that direction. However first I’m looking to take advantage of the electronic format as much as possible… what I’m looking at so far is a kind of “fill in the blanks” concept.

e.g. the template:
damage dealt from to by until

covers a pretty significant chunk of all of the “damage increase/decrease” effects found in the game. I’ve been going through the decks looking for all the effects to come up with a small number of templates that provide good coverage and make sense.

Of course Infernal Relics will probably throw everything for a loop but we’ll cross that bridge when it arrives

Was great to use playing against spite, 'cause I never forgot to heal Spite with any damage he dealt.

With regards to custom cards - I’ve put in a custom for America’s Newest Legacy and Rook City Wraith, which obviously works fine.
With alternate villains coming with the new kickstarter rewards, I think being able to make a custom villain and then assign an existing villain’s deck to that villain would be good (so that Alternate Baron Blade will still have easy access to his minions and such).
The same thing would come in useful if we ever get an alternate Visionary.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
I didn’t include alternates in Sidekick because there’s not much to them as far as the app is concerned – you can just choose Legacy then change the max HP and you’re set. However with the improved select card UI, it might be reasonable to include them as built-in options.

Things have been busy at Handelabra with GAME.minder and Uncle Slam, but I hope to get some time in on Sentinels Sidekick soon. I also want to have effect tracking whenever I play a game with it, so that’s definitely going to be in the next update =)
